title: Technology changes our reality
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What does technology let you change about your own reality?

Jose said that the first philosopher believed, as Jose summarizes it, that humans have to craft their own identity through self-realization, without relying on anything else. He said it is hard to summarize a philosopher.

A student said: so internally driving your own reality. Jose said: that's it. You don't exist outside of your reality. Things like religion are a structure, irrelevant to your self-realization, relevant only because you make them relevant.

Jose said that, as he explains the second philosopher, you build a beautiful house, so you are a wealthy person. That is your personal reality: I feel good about myself, I'm a leader. Another person with a tiny house has another reality.

A student said: like a person living in a cardboard box, whose technology makes them feel like a bum. Jose said: yes, and the other creates a mansion and uses technology to create that power over his reality. Technology helps us change our reality.

A student said: it is an affirmation, an external affirmation of the internal. Jose said: you could say that. Why is it important to the person in the book? If he creates a spaceship that can go to another planet, then we have the power to live in an alternate reality.

He said science fiction is basically how the person lives his life: speculating about alternative ways of life made possible through technological change. Some call it speculative fiction: using your imagination to speculate whether it can become reality.
Jose said that is how he started to imagine alternative worlds, like going to another planet.
What alternative reality would you build if you could?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the reality you have built for yourself with technology.
Write what an external affirmation of your inner life looks like.
Write the speculative story you would write.
Write what in your life is a structure you made relevant.
Write who could check your reading with a philosopher's help.

check.q: What did Jose say technology helps us do?
What did Jose call using imagination to speculate if something can become reality?
What did a student call the technology example?
choices: An external affirmation of the internal

recap: Technology can change your reality. Use imagination to speculate what is possible.
